caption: The drawing depicts a brown bonnet made up of several padded, vertical segments. The main body of the bonnet is rounded and covers the head, extending to the left with visible seams that divide the surface into equal sections. Attached to the bottom edge of the bonnet are two long, wide brown ribbons, which are shown loosely laid out in front of the bonnet. On the right side of the bonnet, there is a gathered portion with a small, dark tassel or bow attached. The background of the drawing is a plain beige or off-white color. In the lower right corner of the image is a simple, lightly sketched outline of the same bonnet, showing its basic shape and seam placement without any shading or color.
title: Silk Bonnet
